items.title: AstraZeneca acquires bacterial vaccine biotech, Omniose
items.summary: Omniose is developing a bioconjugate platform to create vaccines against multidrug resistant superbugs as anti-microbial resistance rises.

items.title: Australia’s largest early-phase clinical trial network expands to Sydney
Longevity sector ambitions outpace regulatory and investment frameworks
items.summary: While investment appetite for longevity is growing, biotech valuations still depend on classic disease-led data packages.

items.title: Moderna’s CEO eyes Keytruda-eclipsing future for personalised cancer vaccine
items.summary: Analysts have placed intismeran central to Moderna’s long-term growth beyond infectious diseases.

items.title: ProBio signs global antibody licensing deal with AbTis
items.summary: ProBio has entered into an exclusive worldwide licensing agreement with South Korean biotechnology firm AbTis to develop and commercialise an early-stage therapeutic antibody asset.
